metadata.description: Agent skill for the kaiten CLI — the Kaiten project management API from the terminal

plugins.name: kaiten
plugins.description: Teaches the agent when and how to reach for the kaiten CLI. Its subcommands are a large flat list whose names cannot be guessed, so the skill makes the agent read `kaiten --help` and `kaiten <subcommand> --help` first, then adds what the help does not cover: config file location, the ID discovery chain (spaces → boards → cards), the two JSON output shapes, pagination, and built-in 429 handling.
